criteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: The sofa reads as intentionally designed upholstered furniture: soft generous cushion volume, gently compressed seats, comfortable arm/back transitions, credible support and an integrated wood understructure. Discarded character remains visible. Improve the hard slab/source construction natively; old silhouette microdetails, mesh counts and exact vertices are not locks.
criteria.evidence: Four registered idle facings at native/logical/phone sizes; full body and underside/side transitions examined at enlarged size. Rear/side volumes must be coherent native continuations of the S view.

criteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: Retain faded rose upholstery, cream replacement seat and warm brown wood/rubbish palette relationships. Warm and richer does not mean uniformly orange, over-saturated candy color or loss of the replacement-seat contrast.
criteria.evidence: Same scene/material setup across all facings and phases, shown on light/gray/dark and registered cream floor.

criteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: Soft broad highlights clarify cushioned convexity; shaded cloth, wooden base and folds stay readable without dead black bands, harsh facet steps or blown rims. Lighting has no preferred horizontal direction and casts no directional floor shadow.
criteria.evidence: One fourfold symmetric or horizontally invariant native light treatment, same camera/materials in all facings. No per-view recolor or fitting. Native light/shader record accompanies pixels.

criteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: Cloth, worn repair/damage, cream stuffing and wood are visually distinct with restrained purposeful detail. Piping/seams follow believable upholstery construction and maintain crisp major forms; damage is a modeled or native-shaded construction, not a floating icon. No demand for exact target stitch/stain count.
criteria.evidence: Close-up S and rear/side, phone-size test, native source material and geometry inspection.

criteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: Whole broken sofa plus supporting rubbish reads immediately at2x2 gameplay scale next to the registered human reference. Major cushions, arms, replacement seat and one clear worn/broken cue remain visible at logical448x576 full frame and half-logical224x288 full frame.
criteria.evidence: Registered human scale, repeated placement and occupied floor contexts at exact pixel pitch; no object fit/zoom/crop presented as logical evidence.

criteria.desiredVisibleOutcome: No visible intersections, coplanar flicker, dark cracks masquerading as seams, flat target cards, broken normals, clipping, edge halos or floating load-bearing feet. Clearance exposes modeled surfaces cleanly and details do not detach accidentally; original intended pieces still separate/shrink/lift as contracted.
criteria.evidence: Every100 native phase PNGs, all original-layout atlases, enlarged key phases,12fps highlighted wrap and clearance one-shot playback, support/floor-reveal contexts and native technical closure.
